INSERT INTO astra_user_search SELECT x.* FROM unnest($1::text[],$2::text[],$3::text[],$4::text[],$5::text[]) AS x(id,username,display_name,normalized_username,normalized_display_name) JOIN users u ON u.id=x.id AND u.username=x.username AND u.display_name=x.display_name FOR SHARE OF u ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET source_username=EXCLUDED.source_username,source_display_name=EXCLUDED.source_display_name,normalized_username=EXCLUDED.normalized_username,normalized_display_name=EXCLUDED.normalized_display_name

WITH cached AS MATERIALIZED (
     SELECT * FROM unnest($2::text[],$3::text[],$4::timestamptz[]) AS c(id,version,created_at)
   )
   SELECT p.id, p.author_id, p.posting_window_id, p.image_id, p.caption, p.visibility,
  p.location_kind, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.locality, p.posted_at,
  w.on_time_deadline, w.ended_at AS window_ended_at,
     CASE WHEN (i.created_at=c.created_at AND i.version=c.version)
       OR (i.asset_key IS NOT NULL AND ?||i.asset_key=c.version)
       THEN NULL ELSE i.data END AS image_data, i.asset_key
   FROM posts p
   JOIN posting_windows w ON w.id = p.posting_window_id
   JOIN LATERAL (
     WITH hinted AS MATERIALIZED (
       SELECT id, data, asset_key, created_at, xmin::text AS version FROM image_objects
       WHERE id = p.image_id AND created_at = p.posted_at
     )
     SELECT id, data, asset_key, created_at, version FROM hinted
     UNION ALL
     SELECT id, data, asset_key, created_at, xmin::text AS version FROM image_objects
     WHERE id = p.image_id AND NOT EX
